pro_course_detail.description:
Here's how it works:

1.) You will send me a message telling me the date by which you need your corrected document and the number of words.

*One hour lesson = up to 1000 words
Package of 5 lessons = up to 5000 words

2.) I will send you a lesson invitation.
IMPORTANT REMINDER: This lesson does not meet in person.

3.) Once you have accepted my invitation, you will send me your document (word, google, or pages doc) in 'messages' BEFORE 10:00 CET (Central European Time) on the day you need your document returned to you. I encourage you to send your document as early as possible.

4.) I will send your document back to you no later than 17:00 CET on the agreed upon day, provided that you have sent the document no later that 10:00 CET of the same day. If I have questions, I appreciate you being available within this time frame via iTalki or Skype chat. This will ensure that the document returned to you will not require further revision.

5.) Once you have received the proof-read document, you can confirm the lesson as having been completed.

6.) If you would like a face-to-face meeting to go over the corrections, this can be done by requesting an additional 30 minute Conversation lesson.

*Trial lesson requests will not be accepted. Thank you for understanding.

pro_course_detail.title: Speak on the Spot! Conversation Practice -  The Learn by Doing Method
pro_course_detail.description:
These sessions are for students who want a diligent one-on-one coach to help them increase their overall English fluency through casual conversation practice.

Learning a second language takes exercise - like learning a dance. In order to really get good at speaking English and not lose that ability (not forget "the moves"), it's important that you build muscle memory in your mouth by using the language frequently and consistently. Unfortunately, there are still many people around the globe who currently don't encounter enough opportunities in their day-to-day lives to practice English. 

Many non-native English speakers after reaching a certain level, never improve their communication skills, and in unfortunate cases, some even start to lose skills they had previously worked hard to gain. 

I enjoy helping students improve their own sentences by identifying and/or recalling sophisticated words and then getting them in the habit of incorporating those words into their speech.

Let's chat about topics of your choice unless you prefer Teacher Amelia to suggest some. During these conversations, Amelia will ask lots of questions so you will learn to use the English language spontaneously and practically rather than from a boring irrelevant textbook. We can discuss unfamiliar vocabulary words, and grammatical rules pertinent to your sentences.

If there's a specific topic you'd like to study, please let me know! I enjoy creating customized materials for my students, tailored to help them achieve their individual goals. Additionally, I've invested in an excellent online resource featuring hundreds of well-organized worksheets, including articles, videos, audio files, vocabulary exercises, and discussion questions. These resources can be utilized to keep our "free conversation" lessons centered around specific topics that interest and motivate you. I'm also eager to hear about your career and any personal life updates you'd like to share during our conversations.

pro_course_detail.description:
Each lesson will contain one or more of each area (grammar, speaking, listening, writing, and vocabulary) and will be tailored to your needs all the while using interesting and relevant topics. I’ll always include tips, resources, and tools to help you reach your language goals. 

Grammar: Practice grammar structures and focus on the areas that are problematic for you and you’ll be given practice exercises and tools that help you grasp grammar concepts.

Speaking: Talk about your favorite topics and hobbies all the while focusing on your pronunciation, intonation, and word stress. Many English learners have a wide vocabulary but sadly aren’t understood because they lack understanding of word stress and intonation. 

Listening: Perhaps you can read and speak English well, but you struggle listening to a conversation. You’ll practice by listening to interesting short audio and video clips and then we will discuss the content. 

Writing: Whether you’re writing an email or an essay, I’ll help you develop your writing skills and focus on content, style, and punctuation. 

Vocabulary: Learning new words is essential as a language learner. In every lesson, you will be exposed to new words and discuss their meaning, range, and pronunciation.

pro_course_detail.title: Interview Preparation (expertise in U.S. Government Jobs)
pro_course_detail.description:
Hi there! 

Whether you have a job interview in the government or in the private sector, I can support you to BE your best. I highlight the word BE because I believe the key to a successful interview is feeling confident and at ease, so that your authentic self and capabilities naturally come through.  

I worked eight years as a spokesperson for a U.S.government agency. I was interviewed hundreds of times for radio/TV shows and newspapers.  Looking back, it is hard to believe.  I am naturally an introvert and in my early professional years I could not sleep the night before a presentation. I took many trainings and learned many cognitive skills to cope with my nervousness.  However, what really helped me was learning about how the nervous systems works and simple, yet potent, practices to stay present in my body while connecting to others. 

In addition, I have interviewed hundreds of potential job candidates for U.S government positions.  The majority of the candidates I recommended were hired successfully.  I have a gift for aligning the right candidate with the right manager.  

I look forward to sharing my experience with you.   Here are some of the services I offer: 

•	Create customized interview questions based on your resume and the job description.  (If you would like me to create customized interview questions, please send me your resume and job description in advance.) 

•	Conduct a practice interview during which I will give you feedback on how to communicate verbally and non-verbally in a clear and confident manner.   

•	Enhance your vocabulary with Business English expressions.

•	Provide suggestions on how to answer "tricky" questions and what to ask. 

•	Help  you identify strengths that might not be apparent to you.  

•	Help you explore if the job is aligned with your experience, values, and goals.

•	Introduce you to some practices that will help you minimize your normal nervousness by staying connected to your body and the environment.

pro_course_detail.title: Preparación para entrevistas (experta en empleos del gobierno de Estados Unidos)
pro_course_detail.description:
¡Saludos! 
Si tiene una entrevista de trabajo ya sea con el sector privado o con el gobierno de los Estados  puedo ayudarle a SER lo mejor posible. Destaco la palabra SER porque creo que la clave del éxito de una entrevista es sentirse seguro y cómodo, para que su auténtico yo y sus capacidades se expresen de forma natural.  

Trabajé ocho años como portavoz de una agencia del gobierno de los Estados Unidos. Me entrevistaron cientos de veces para programas de radio, televisión y periódicos.  Mirando atrás, es difícil de creer.  Soy introvertida por naturaleza y en mis primeros años profesionales no podía dormir la noche anterior a una presentación. Tomé muchos cursos de formación y aprendí muchas habilidades cognitivas para hacer frente a mi nerviosismo.  Sin embargo, lo que realmente me ayudó fue aprender cómo funciona el sistema nervioso y prácticas sencillas, pero potentes, para mantenerme presente en mi cuerpo mientras conectaba con los demás. 

Además, he entrevistado a cientos de candidatos para puestos en el gobierno de los Estados Unidos.  La mayoría de los que recomendé  fueron contratados.  

Deseo compartir mi experiencia con usted.  A continuación describo algunos de los servicios que puedo ofrecerle: 
•	Crear preguntas personalizadas con base en su resume y la descripción del trabajo. (Si desea que prepare preguntas personalizadas, por favor envíeme estos documentos con anticipación.)  
•	Hacer una simulación de entrevista en la que le daré sugerencias sobre como comunicarse de manera verbal y no verbal en un modo claro y con confianza. 
•	Compartir expresiones usadas en el Español  para negocios. 
•	Proveerle sugerencias sobre cómo responder a preguntas difíciles.
•	Identificar fortalezas de las cuales quizás no se haya percatado.
•	Ayudarle a explorar si el trabajo se ajusta a su experiencia, valores y metas. 
•	Compartir algunas práctica que le ayudarán a minimizar su nerviosismo normal al mantenerse conectado con su cuerpo y ambiente.
